description: This PHP source file defines the class 'DetailViewMerge', which extends 'EditViewMerge' and handles merging of metadata for the 'DetailView' in the SuiteCRM module UpgradeWizard/SugarMerge. It includes class properties and methods for processing view definitions, panel analysis, and field merging related to detail views.
